block-design.alt: Forty tomato plants, the experimental units, are split into two blocks by location: 24 plants on a sunny bench and 16 on a shady bench. Within each block, random assignment puts half the plants on fertilizer A and half on fertilizer B (12 and 12 on the sunny bench, 8 and 8 on the shady bench). The response, tomato weight, is compared within each block. Each block is a small completely randomized experiment.
